name: job-watcher
description: Watches company career pages and shows new jobs for your experience level.

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm: npm i -g pnpm, then pnpm install" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --if-present run typecheck
